summary: This bill eliminates the diversity immigrant visa program by repealing section 203(c) of the Immigration and Nationality Act and making conforming technical changes to related provisions, effective October 1, 2025.

scores.thoughts: The bill contains no provisions related to federal spending, appropriations, or budget allocations. It solely amends immigration statutes to eliminate a visa category.
No tax-related language, rate changes, credits, or revenue measures appear in the bill.
The legislation does not address healthcare policy, insurance, or medical services.
No references to firearms, regulations, or Second Amendment issues.

The bill's sole purpose is to repeal the diversity visa lottery (INA section 203(c)) and make conforming amendments. This directly eliminates an existing legal immigration pathway, thereby restricting immigration opportunities.
No content concerning reproductive rights or abortion access.
No defense, military, or national security spending provisions.
The bill does not engage with environmental regulations or climate policy.
No welfare, benefits, or entitlement program changes are included.
Education policy is untouched by this legislation.
No drug enforcement or decriminalization measures.
The bill does not address sentencing, policing, or criminal justice reform.
No trade, tariffs, or globalization provisions.
No fiscal policy or debt-related language.
No provisions affecting LGBTQ legal protections.
Foreign aid is not mentioned.
No election integrity or voting access measures.
Technology regulation and privacy issues are absent.
No labor, union, or employment law changes.
The bill does not address religious exemptions or civil rights priorities.
